financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of 2,068,246 shares of common stock in January 2024
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In January 2024, the Company issued 2,068,246 shares of Common Stock under the ATM for net proceeds of $7.9 million, or $3.84 per share.

warrants.quote: the Company issued the Loan Warrant to purchase 730,769 shares of Common Stock at an exercise price of $1.95 with a ten-year contractual term
